commits.subject: crypt: made TSha3Context public
commits.body: - so that we don't need to mess with "packed record" and hidden structures
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: rewritten TNetSocketWrap.Close/SetLinger methods
commits.body:
- audited and fixed the behavior on Windows, POSIX and even MacOS
- feedback is welcome: no error appeared from our preliminary testing
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: core: avoid "packed record" definition unless really needed
commits.body: - since it has a huge performance cost on ARM
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: crypt: made TShaContext public
commits.body:
- to be shared by both SHA-1 and SHA-2 implementation routines
- use of "packed record" was pointless and generate sub-optimal code on arm32/aarch64
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: crypt: removed TAesContext confusing structure
commits.body:
- we should have just put all the fields as private in TAes record
- use of "packed record" was pointless and generate sub-optimal code on arm32/aarch64
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

+procedure _xasmsquarediagonal(Src, Dst: pointer; Count: PtrUInt);
+  assembler; nostackframe;
+asm
+  // x0=Src x1=Dst x2=Count

+  lsr    x7, x4, #63
+  adds   x5, x5, x3

+        add     edx, edx
+        adc     ebx, 0
+        add     edx, eax
+        adc     ebx, 0
+        mov     dword ptr [edi], edx
+        add     esi, 2
+        add     edi, 4
+        dec     ecx             // ecx=Count
+        jnz     @s
+        pop     edi
+        pop     esi
+        pop     ebx
